## About Me

<!-- CHANGE THIS: two or three sentences about yourself -->

I'm a student in the MUSA program at Penn. My background is in
computer science and data science. I have research experience in educational technologies and learning science. I have been working as a software engineer for the past 3 years. I'm interested in exploring the intersection of data and urban issues to create opportunities to expand information accessibility.
